course.title: GMAT Focus: Data Insights
course.description: Master the five Data Insights question types with GMAT-specific strategy videos from top prep channels. Covers Data Sufficiency, Multi-Source Reasoning, Table Analysis, Graphical Interpretation, and Two-Part Analysis. Powered by active recall.

curriculum.title: Data Insights Overview
curriculum.description: General strategy and approach for the Data Insights section.

topics.title: How to Approach GMAT Data Insights

sources.title: GMAT Ninja DI Ep 0: How to Approach GMAT Data Insights
sources.note: Overview of the DI section: 5 question types, 20 questions, 45 minutes

curriculum.title: Data Sufficiency
curriculum.description: Data Sufficiency questions test your ability to determine whether given information is sufficient to answer a question. This is the most heavily tested question type in DI (6-8 questions).

sources.title: GMAT Ninja DI Ep 9: How to Approach Data Sufficiency
sources.note: Core strategy for DS questions - understanding the 5 answer choices

topics.title: Common DS Traps and How to Avoid Them

sources.title: GMAT Ninja: How to Avoid Screwing Yourself on Data Sufficiency
sources.note: Common DS traps including Yes/No questions and statement evaluation

curriculum.title: Graphical Interpretation
curriculum.description: GI questions present data visually through graphs, charts, and diagrams. You must extract specific values or relationships from these visuals (4-6 questions).

sources.title: GMAT Ninja DI Ep 1: Graphical Interpretation -- Just Read the Bleeping Graph

topics.title: Unusual Graphs and Key Quant Skills

sources.title: GMAT Ninja DI Ep 2: Graphical Interpretation -- Fun with Unusual Graphs
GMAT Ninja DI Ep 3: Key Quant Skills for Graphical Interpretation
sources.note: Math skills commonly tested in GI questions

sources.title: GMAT Ninja: Graphical Interpretation -- Yes, These Graphs Sometimes Suck... By Design
sources.note: Deliberately tricky graphs and how to handle them

curriculum.title: Table Analysis
curriculum.description: Table Analysis questions present data in sortable tables. You must analyze the data to determine whether statements are true (2-4 questions).

sources.title: GMAT Ninja DI Ep 4: Table Analysis -- This is Pretty Much Excel
sources.note: Core approach to TA questions - treat it like a spreadsheet

sources.title: GMAT Ninja: Table Analysis -- Embracing Excel Gone (Sorta) Wrong
sources.note: Advanced TA strategies and common traps

curriculum.title: Multi-Source Reasoning
curriculum.description: MSR questions provide information across multiple tabs (text, tables, charts). You must synthesize information from different sources (2-4 questions).

sources.title: GMAT Ninja DI Ep 7: Intro to Multi-Source Reasoning
sources.note: Core approach to navigating multiple information sources

sources.title: GMAT Ninja DI Ep 8: Key Reminders for Multi-Source Reasoning
GMAT Ninja: Multi-Source Reasoning -- How to Eat an Elephant
sources.note: Breaking down complex MSR prompts into manageable pieces

curriculum.title: Two-Part Analysis
curriculum.description: Two-Part Analysis questions require solving problems with two interdependent components - either math-based or logic-based (2-4 questions).

sources.title: GMAT Ninja DI Ep 5: Two-Part Analysis -- Verbal-Based Questions
sources.note: TPA questions involving arguments, logic, and CR-style reasoning

sources.title: GMAT Ninja DI Ep 6: Two-Part Analysis -- Quant-based Questions
sources.note: TPA questions involving systems of equations, ratios, work/rate

sources.title: GMAT Ninja: Two-Part Analysis -- When Quant and CR Eat the Wrong Type of Mushrooms
sources.note: Hybrid TPA questions and unusual formats

practice_resources.title: GMAT Official Practice Questions
practice_resources.description: Official GMAC practice questions are the gold standard for DI practice.

notes.video_sources: All videos from GMAT Ninja's free Data Insights video course
notes.question_type_distribution: Data Sufficiency (~6-8), Graphical Interpretation (~4-6), Table Analysis (~2-4), Multi-Source Reasoning (~2-4), Two-Part Analysis (~2-4)
notes.section_order_tip: Many high scorers recommend doing Data Insights first or second, as fatigue can hurt performance on this detail-oriented section.
